method_note_isolation: --android-native-target moves a library into an isolated Android namespace so DT_NEEDED picks the APK's copy. Isolating more than necessary is not free: a library whose weak libc references resolve in the default namespace can find them unresolved in the isolated one, and a weak symbol binds to zero rather than failing the load. Use the forward dependency closure of the library that failed, not every library that reaches the shadowed one.
